    Aenid Kingdom¶

    "Mabode came from the stars to save humanity."

    The Aenid Kingdom is a human monarchy in West Erisdar, situated at the edge of the Lyrical Forest and within sight of Matterbleak. The kingdom's history is inseparable from the forest — early Aenid settlers learned, through catastrophic trial and error, that the Lyrical Forest is not merely a collection of trees but a repository of something the locals call "the chorus": residual consciousness imprints from the fallen soldiers of the Last Great War, bound to the wood they died among.

    Governance is a hereditary monarchy under the Aen line, whose legitimacy rests on an ancient compact with the forest itself — or, as skeptics note, on a carefully maintained tradition of not angering whatever lives there. The current king maintains a court that is notably smaller, quieter, and more superstitious than those of comparable kingdoms. Aenid law mandates that no tree within a league of the forest's edge may be cut; the kingdom imports all its timber from the interior, at considerable expense.

    Relations with Matterbleak are close but somber — the two settlements share the same psychological weight, the same learned caution, the same unspoken understanding that some places on Ge'or were not meant for human habitation and that humans live there anyway. With the rest of Erisdar, Aenid maintains minimal contact — the kingdom is not hostile, merely preoccupied with a neighbor that cannot be reasoned with, traded with, or ignored.

    The Aenid Kingdom is a nation in West Erisdar, situated near Matterbleak and the Lyrical Forest.

    Geography — The Desert¶

    The Aenid Kingdom is situated in a desertic region. All of that area — including the island of Erima, which the kingdom owns — is desert. Its neighbors share the same aridity: Augagarten is desertic, and Astravayne is a lot desertic too.

    The desert shapes the kingdom as much as the forest does: a hard land that produces hard, honor-bound people.

    Religion — Shurtra¶

    Aenid follows Shurtra, founded by Mabode — a philosopher king born on Erima island roughly 200 years before the founding of the Erisian church. Shurtra is therefore about 200 years older than the Erisian Church.

    Shurtra worships Mabode, saying he came from the stars to save humanity. The faith's name means "righteousness" — its language, Shurtraliot, means "righteous language", and is commonly spoken throughout the kingdom.

    Honor and death cults: Shurtra men are highly expected to be extremely honorable. That impossible standard makes death cults common — which leads the authorities to usually crack down on them.

    Enemy of the Church: Aenid is a fierce enemy of the Erisian church — the Church conquered a lot of Shurtra's lands, and Aenid has never forgiven it.

    Naval Power & the Luminous Ocean¶

    Despite its forest-bound reputation, Aenid is the largest and most politically organized maritime power of the Luminous Sea Islands region — a kingdom in name and function. It maintains the region's only significant naval force and projects influence over the smaller island nations. Its monarch claims sovereignty over the entire Luminous Ocean; the other islands acknowledge this about as much as they have to.

    The kingdom's position on the West Erisdar coast lets it face two directions at once: inland toward the forest that shapes its soul, and seaward toward the glowing waters it quietly dominates. Aenid's navy is the kingdom's one extravagance — the same culture that forbids cutting a tree within a league of the forest's edge spends lavishly on hulls, sails, and cannon.

    Connections¶

    • Region: West Erisdar
    • Nearby: Matterbleak, Lyrical Forest
    • Sea: Luminous Ocean — claims sovereignty
    • Archipelago: Luminous Sea Islands
    • Owns: Erima island
    • Religion: Shurtra — star-born faith of Mabode; Shurtraliot language
    • Rival: Erisian church — conquered much of Shurtra's lands
    • Character: Desert kingdom, forest-cautious, naval-dominant, honor-bound, superstitious monarchy
